# Additions to Esther Chapter 1 (Addition A) — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Codex Vaticanus, Additions to Esther A | **Source Image:** source-texts/greek-DC/ADE_001_page_001.jpg

---

*[Addition A: Mordecai's dream and the discovery of the conspiracy against the king. Placed before Hebrew Esther 1:1.]*

**1:1** In-the second year of-the reign of Artaxerxes the-great, on the-first day of Nisan, Mordecai son-of Jair son-of Shimei son-of Kish, of-the tribe of Benjamin, had a dream —

**1:2** a Jewish man dwelling in-the city of Susa, a man great and serving in-the court of-the king.

**1:3** He-was of-the captives whom Nebuchadnezzar king of-Babylon had-led-captive from Jerusalem with Jeconiah the-king of Judea.

**1:4** And this is his dream: And behold, voices and noise and thunders, earthquake and turmoil upon the-earth.

**1:5** And behold, two great dragons came-forward, both ready for combat, and a great cry came-forth from-them.

**1:6** And at their cry every nation prepared itself for war, to-fight against the-nation of-the righteous.

**1:7** And behold, a day of-darkness and gloom — tribulation and distress and great affliction upon the-earth.

**1:8** And all-the righteous nation was-troubled, fearing their own evils; and they-made-ready to-perish.

**1:9** And they-cried out to God. And from their cry there-arose as-though from a small spring a great river with abundant water.

**1:10** Light came-forth and the-sun rose, and the-humble were-exalted and devoured the-honored.

**1:11** And having-awakened from the-dream and the-visions, Mordecai held in-his-heart and sought to-understand it in every regard.

**1:12** And Mordecai was-resting in-the court with Gabatha and Tharra, the-two eunuchs of-the king who-were guarding the-court.

**1:13** And he-heard their deliberations and searched-out their concerns, and he-learned that they-were-preparing to-lay-hands upon Artaxerxes the-king; and he-informed the-king concerning them.

**1:14** And the-king examined the-two eunuchs, and having-confessed they-were-led-away.

**1:15** And the-king wrote these-things as a memorial.

**1:16** And Mordecai wrote concerning these-things.

**1:17** And the-king ordered Mordecai to-serve in the-court and gave to him gifts for these-things.
